sessions.intent: Build the PlangOS stage-1 image (Debian + plang + Chromium, sealed WSL rootfs tarball) and run the checks that can run without Windows.

before.assumptions: Plan in /shared/os/start.md agreed with Ingi. Rootless podman is broken in this box (newuidmap); buildah with chroot isolation inside unshare -rm works. dpkg install scripts fail under a single-uid userns, so the rootfs is assembled with dpkg-deb -x.
before.risk: Image size vs 300 MB limit; Chromium running without its install scripts; no Windows to test WSL.

actions.context: Rootfs assembled from sha256-locked Debian snapshot packages with dpkg-deb -x, with no container runtime, no root and no maintainer scripts. Tried buildah+apt first; dbus/systemd postinst scripts fail unprivileged, and skipping them also keeps systemd/dbus/PAM/shells out. Deny-list is justified per line.

First image was 398 MB gzip. Denied Mesa (LLVM/gallium/z3, 192 MB uncompressed; libgbm doesn't link it, Chromium uses its own SwiftShader with --disable-gpu), removed the Vulkan validation layer, and switched to xz (fixed block size, so deterministic): 224 MB.

checks.py covers checks 1.4 and 1.6 plus ELF NEEDED resolution (caught dri_gbm.so and the .NET LTTng provider needing denied libs). run-local.sh uses pivot_root because the kernel refuses user namespaces inside a chroot, which blocks Chromium's sandbox. tardiff.py found the one reproducibility leak (ldconfig aux-cache).
Seal: interop off, automount off, default user plang, no [boot] command (would run plang as root). passwd shell = plang for both users.
start.ps1 copied from the /shared/os draft. dev/import.ps1 is a stand-in for start.goal until host plang has terminal/container modules; untested (no Windows here).
Measured: 224.3 MB xz; two clean builds identical (d148f01b…); plang publish byte-identical; plang starts 1.4-2.5 s; Chromium renders as uid 10001 with sandbox.

after.status: Stage-1 image builds; checks 1.4 (Linux half), 1.5 and 1.6 pass. WSL checks pending on Windows.
after.notes: Blocked for a full console run: pre-built .pr files in app-systems are outdated (PrFormatOutdated), so a Start.goal needs plang build with an LLM. Host start.goal needs PLang-side terminal/container/Service/channel work.
